author: aliaksandrak
quote: people who give this game anything above a 1 must be bots. this was absolutely horrible and tarnishes the name of GTA. no issue if they released this under a different name but this is absolutely NOT a GTA game. the characters are annoying and boring to play, the plot makes no sense, the game feels like a dating simulator and that's coming from a woman. if i wanted to date girls and fix houses, I'd just play sims. what are you doing Rockstar, seriously?
